spec.question: Does learner-visible relational geometry causally change development when exposure quantity/order, affordances, outcomes, raw-value marginals and search budget are matched?
spec.incumbent: Current Microseed development is determined by available evidence/owners; geometry adds no independent effect once exposure/access/order/search are matched.
spec.rival: CFE-style relational visibility/topology changes which useful representations/relations become discoverable even with matched exposure and budget.
spec.manipulation: Create two synthetic developmental worlds with the same opaque value marginals, interaction count, action set, outcome frequencies, temporal order and search budget. Only alter which value pairs/relations are jointly visible within the projection/discovery neighborhood; use topology permutation so semantic labels cannot leak.
spec.incumbent_prediction: Qualified projection/relation discovery rate and downstream capability are invariant across geometry conditions within seed variance.
spec.rival_prediction: One geometry reliably enables a specific projection/relation/capability that the matched alternative fails to discover, and the effect reverses with topology reversion.
spec.measurement: Projection candidates, qualification/currentness, learned relation support, downstream bounded task success, discovery attempts/search budget.
spec.minimal_embodiment: Research-only synthetic projection-discovery fixture using existing opaque projection owners; no CFE mechanism imported into production.
spec.falsifier: Any apparent geometry effect disappears after matching access/order/search or under opaque topology permutation.
spec.loop_plus: If effect exists, separate geometry from identifiability/access before attributing developmental causality.
